title: Task - Feasibility
evidence: The task requires building a Godot prototype. Godot Engine 4.7-stable is installed on the CUA VM at /opt/godot (confirmed in cua-applications.csv line 44). The task involves creating scenes, scripts, and assets within Godot, running the project, taking a screenshot, and capturing console output — all standard operations available within the VM. No external services, credentials, captchas, or login walls are required. All four input files (source_coin_token.png, Bomb.glb, scene_reference.png, gameplay_config.txt) are placed on the Desktop. All three deliverables (.zip, .png, .txt) can be produced entirely within the VM.
